Dear all,

please see the attached announcement for two of the highly recommended Stats intro workshops (Boot camps) in SE Asia.

Best regards  --- Marc

From: Mike [work...@bcss.org.my]
Sent: 03 November 2019 01:07
Subject: Stats Boot Camps and other training opportunities

Greetings everyone,

In 2019 we ran Boot Camps in Malaysia, Myanmar, Thailand and Bhutan, plus an instructor training workshop in Bhutan; details are here. We are now planning our programme for 2020 and we have two Boot Camps in Malaysia lined up for the start of the year:

 * 12-23 January 2020 at UNIMAS in Sarawak
 
 * 3-14 February 2020 at Sunway University in Kuala Lumpur
 
Details and links to application forms are on our BCSS home page.

We plan to return to Thailand and Bhutan later in the year, and are discussing plans for Philippines, Indonesia and Bangladesh too. We'll let you know more as soon as details are finalised.

Please pass on this information and the link to bcss.org.my to your friends and colleagues who would be interested and we hope to see you at one of our workshops soon.

Regards,  Mike

PS: If you don't want to receive these emails in future, just hit "Reply" and let me know.
-- 
Mike Meredith / BCSS Vice-Chair and Workshop Coordinator
Ngumbang Juat / BCSS Chief Instructor
Pls use work...@bcss.org.my for workshop-related stuff
